positions.name: OwnedVersusRentedIntelligence
positions.frame: what separates intelligence an individual owns from intelligence they rent, and where does the lasting asset sit when the substrate is interchangeable?
positions.why: Both statements draw the same antithesis between rented and owned intelligence. src-2 states the contrast at the level of intelligence itself. src-3 locates it in substrate versus perspective. The dimensional reads show parallel antithetical phrasing, a present-tense generic assertion, and autonomy as the implied good. Both are held at claim strength. Read together, they carry the individually-owned-intelligence thesis. src-4 names that thesis but only as a pointer, so it stays out of the group. No existing positions, narratives or strata offer a leaf to sit under, so `under` is omitted.
